messages:
Nora: Quick run we should calm the Private setup wizard's Connectivity step. Users see a wall of text + logs and panic.
Eli: Strong agree. Show a short outcome banner first: PASS / ACTION REQUIRED. No raw logs up front.
Zoe: For failures, show 1-line cause + 1 recommended fix. Eg: 'Egress IP blocked : allow outbound to 3.14.159.0/24 or configure NAT.' Add a tiny 'Copy command' snippet for advanced users.
Carlos: For CIDR overlap suggest a non-conflicting range and preview the change in a diff view; require explicit accept. Don't auto-apply.
preflight-bot: scan-complete: 5 checks, 1 blocking, 1 warn.
Nora: Accessibility: focus the banner, aria-live="assertive" on final failure, use polite for progress. Always include text labels (Passed/Failed) not color only.
Eli: Per-check UI: icon + short title + status + two actions (Re-run async, Help). Keep details collapsed. Stream per-row status with spinner + final text.
Zoe: Mobile: only banner + primary CTA. Expand details on tap.
Carlos: Add 'Download report' (small JSON) for ops. Also include KB links for AWS SG/GCP firewall examples.
Nora: I'll update Figma copy and drop in a11y notes. We'll prototype next sprint. :rocket:
